decisions.reason: Changing the Power Board's mounting orientation does not alter the established three-board architecture.
The orientation decision does not change the requirement for an NTC contact on the battery connector.
The mechanical orientation change does not modify battery cutoff or thermal-protection behavior.
The Power Board's vertical fit requirement does not affect its TVS ESD protection.
The source decision concerns Power Board mounting and does not change charge-status indication through the Main Board LED chain.
Mechanical orientation of the Power Board does not alter ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The mounting-orientation change does not affect I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The source decision does not change the software-switched 5V rail's control, default state, or operating pattern.
The proposed 3D-printed support and vertical orientation do not change the connector sourceability policy.
